conventions.convention: Paths start at vertex 0, have length n, and stay within vertices 0 through ℓ−2, with ℓ≥3. Empty endpoint spaces are omitted. Prefix inclusion appends one adjacent vertex; path bases are orthonormal.
The XXZ basis is ↑↑, ↑↓, ↓↑, ↓↓; the mixed block has diagonal q⁻¹,q and off-diagonal entries −1. Here q=e^(iγ), δ=q+q⁻¹, and H=−Σe_i over the L−1 open bonds.

Potts shifts send |a⟩ to |a−1 mod Q⟩. Odd generators act on sites, even generators on adjacent pairs, and the open chain has 2L−1 generators. For Q=2,3,4, δ=√Q and q is respectively e^(iπ/4), e^(iπ/6),1.

Inclusion appends a rightmost vertical strand. Right closure joins the rightmost top and bottom endpoints, removes circles with weight δ, and is normalized as E_n=δ⁻¹c_n for δ≠0. The involution is conjugate-linear horizontal reflection for real δ.

The trace radical is the radical of the bilinear pairing τ_n(yx), rather than the Jacobson radical. The algebraic closure identities require δ≠0; positivity additionally requires the stated C*-structure and faithful positive traces.

AC is assumed throughout the operator-algebra construction. Scalar Hilbert inner products are linear in the first variable; right-module-valued inner products are conjugate-linear in the first variable. Normality means WOT continuity on operator-norm bounded balls.
Ordinary Jones index is dim_N L²(M), without an assumed bounded frame. Right multiplication satisfies R_aR_b=R_ba. Extremality compares the normalized module trace of R_a with τ_M(a) for a∈N′∩M.
The Jones tower starts with M_−1=N and M_0=M; e_i projects L²(M_(i−1)) onto L²(M_(i−2)), and the diagram generators are U_i=√λ e_i.

load_bearing.statement: Assume AC. For a finite tracial von Neumann algebra (A,t), the left and right standard actions are mutual commutants; right-bounded standard vectors are represented by elements of A; every positive normal functional is a vector functional on L²(A). Every unital von Neumann subalgebra D admits a unique normal faithful trace-preserving conditional expectation, given by the L² orthogonal projection and contractive and D-bimodular.

Assume AC. Every normal unital right Hilbert-space module over a finite tracial algebra N has an arbitrary-index projection model with its model-independent canonical faithful normal semifinite trace. If N is a II1 factor and the dimension is finite, the module is pL²(N)^k for finite k, with dimension (Tr_k⊗t)(p).

Assume AC and ordinary finite Jones index λ for N⊂M. Then B=(right N)′=W*(M,e) is a II1 factor, Tr_B(1)=λ, Tr_B(e)=1, and Tr_B(xey)=τ(yx). Its normalized trace-preserving expectation satisfies F(xey)=λ⁻¹xy. Every T∈B has a unique bounded x∈M with Te=xe, necessarily x=λF(Te); every right-N bounded vector in L²(M) belongs to M.

Assume AC and ordinary finite Jones index. There is a bounded finite Parseval frame u_j with Σu_jeu_j*=1, x=Σu_jE_N(u_j*x), and Σu_ju_j*=λ1. Its coordinates identify M with pN^k and L²(M) with pL²(N)^k; every bounded right-N endomorphism preserves M.

For n≥1 and δ≠0, inclusion is injective and unital, E_nι_n=id, E_n is bimodular and trace-preserving, and E_n(ι_n(x)d_n)=δ⁻¹x. For real nonzero δ with compatible finite-dimensional C*-structures and faithful positive Markov traces, E_n is positive.

At q=e^(πi/ℓ), ℓ≥3, the trace-radical quotient is the actual retained type-A path matrix tower. Reflection gives its finite-dimensional C*-structure and faithful positive closure trace; normalized right closure is the positive trace-preserving expectation, with matrix-unit coefficient [c+1]/(δ[a+1]) for equal predecessor endpoints and zero for different predecessors.

An ordinary finite-index II1 inclusion gives a full tower of II1 factors with constant adjacent index λ, bounded finite frames, and normalized trace τ_i(xe_iy)=λ⁻¹τ_(i−1)(yx). Extremality propagates when assumed initially. Both adjacent Jones projection relations hold, and U_i=√λe_i give compatible trace-preserving representations of the finite diagram tower, including index one.
